context.snippet:
Cathie Wood is swapping Google for Meta as AI takes center stage. But is Meta the better bet now?
About Meta Stock If there is one tech giant that has become almost impossible to avoid in everyday digital life, it is Meta Platforms. Founded as Facebook in February 2004 by Mark Zuckerberg and headquartered in Menlo Park, California, Meta has transformed far beyond its social-networking beginnings. Today, its sprawling ecosystem includes Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and Threads, as well as Meta AI, Quest headsets, and AI-powered smart glasses. For billions of people, Meta's apps are already deeply embedded in everyday life. But Meta's next big chapter is not really about social media. It is about AI. The company is pouring money and resources into AI with the goal of reshaping virtually every part of its ecosystem. And instead of making users learn yet another platform, Meta is putting AI directly into the apps they already use.
